relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the TLR4 inhibitor decreased the cellular levels of mtROS (Fig. 6d), indicating that the production of mtROS in NPCs was regulated by TLR4.

relationships.subject: mitochondrial ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibiting TLR4 and mtROS reduced dsRNA levels, indicating that TLR4/mtROS mediated LPS-induced dsRNA accumulation

relationships.subject: dsRNA
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that dsRNA, which is a downstream signaling molecule of TLR4 and mtROS, mediates the activation of PKR and the ISR, thus leading to the synthesis and release of CCL2/7

relationships.subject: integrated stress response
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that ATF3 was regulated by the ISR in degenerated NPCs

relationships.subject: ATF3
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that ATF3 directly bound to the Ccl2/7 promoters to regulate their expression

relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that degenerated NPCs recruit and promote the proinflammatory MΦ phenotype through the CCL2/7-CCR2 axis.

key_findings: TLR4/mtROS/dsRNA activates PKR-mediated integrated stress response in nucleus pulposus cells, driving ATF3-dependent CCL2/7 production.
CCL2/7-CCR2 signaling recruits and polarizes pro-inflammatory macrophages; ISR inhibition, bindarit or CCR2 knockout alleviated disc degeneration in vivo.
